notes.title: Incarnation Goes Free to Play!
notes.content:
Hi again!

[i][b]I'm happy to announce that Incarnation will be free-to-play starting February 24th![/b][/i]

Incarnation was a major step in solodev for me. It started as an experiment as part of my studies in university, asking the question "what if roguelike but in reverse?", and became a deeply personal project for me. As my journey has taken me toward new horizons, I want as many people as possible to experience it, so I’m making it free!

My focus is now on my first commercial project: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2860990/Nautical_Survival/][b]Nautical Survival[/b][/url].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2860990/Nautical_Survival/][b]Nautical Survival[/b][/url] is a survivors-like game where you captain an armed sea vessel to fight off hordes of oceanic terrors. It also has some cool twists like crew promotions, exploration, outpost upgrades, pick-up-and-deliver mechanics and more. The game has been under development for a little bit more than a year and is coming to Early Access April, and I can't wait for you to try it!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2860990/Nautical_Survival/


In the meantime, feel free to dive back into Incarnation now that it’s free. Thank you for following along on this journey.

Stay tuned for more updates on Nautical Survival, and happy gaming!

[i]Stay afloat,
Idan[/i]
